Rosa (Marketing): Quick pulse 1 - dashboard shows our webinar registration funnel conversion dipped overnight. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-pulse :mag:
Ethan (Growth): saw that too. Could this be the A/B copy test we launched?
Priya (Analytics): looking at cohorts. Control funnel steady, variant B conversion is 29% lower.
Sam (Product): Variant B removes the secondary CTA to reduce noise. maybe we removed a helpful reassurance line.
Rosa (Marketing): interesting. This is the first time a copy A/B has given this big a hit. Any qualitative feedback from chat?
Ethan (Growth): some comments on the post mentioned "register button not obvious" after we launched the new hero.
infra-bot: scheduled check: synthetic registration test failed 1/5 attempts 2026-04-12T02:10Z - investigating slow JS load.
Priya (Analytics): running funnel-level backfill now, will add an annotation to the KPI deck and provide adjusted week-over-week numbers. ETA 90m.
Sam (Product): small rollback or copy tweak might be fastest. Rosa, want to run a 24h swap back to control?
Rosa (Marketing): yes let's rollback variant B for 24h and re-evaluate. Ethan, please coordinate with socials to pause paid promos to variant B until we confirm.
Ethan (Growth): on it.
Rosa (Marketing): addition: Priya, can you include device breakdown? mobile seems worse for this variant.
notes: This thread captures a short ops/debugging flow after a funnel dip. Actions are clear and timeboxed.
